authorization: Kevin requested broader spatial-method research, preservation of true presences, and a practical point-density approach rather than making reconstructed effort a prerequisite.

weighting.formula: Raw w_i = 1/[1 + sum_j max(1-d_ij/h,0)^alpha], excluding self; h=10km, alpha=1. Normalize positive weights to the original training presence count.
weighting.scale_choice: One declared support within the already examined neighborhood range; gradual weighting instead of deletion. Neither an inferred effort bandwidth nor a biologically optimal separation distance; no new support-scale search.
weighting.distance: WGS84 cell-center geodesic distance between permitted training presences only. Retain original source uncertainties and guarded validation.
weighting.information: Keep every original presence row with positive weight. Save raw and normalized weights, geographic/climate/source influence summaries and Kish effective n. Kish n measures weight concentration, not independent biological sampling units.

borders: Reuse exact per-family parent training-only cutoff files; original p+q rows and features are unchanged.
background: Unchanged area/inclusion quadrature, including occupied cells. No presence-exclusion buffers, focal KDE bias background, changed calibration area or assertion of absences.
normalization: Same original n positive mass, n background mass and 0.03*n effective damping; only the distribution of positive mass among retained cells changes.
validation: Same 21 inherited development folds, held presences and complete target landscapes; preserve both occupied-block and recorded-cell scoring. These scores evaluate prediction of recorded patterns and cannot establish ecological debiasing.
selection: No inner tuning, environmental-cluster deduplication, lat/lon ecological predictor, best-scoring scale selection or automatic model replacement.
stop: Freeze all 21 weight vectors before fitting; complete at most 42 fixed fits, compare to exact parent equal-cell fits, save source and weight diagnostics, then stop this comparison. No full-data fit or historical projection.
